definition: Unfortunate and unable to escape an undesirable situation.
author: John Milton
quote: This saw his hapless Foes, but stood obdur’d, And to rebellious fight rallied thir Powers Insensate, hope conceiving from despair.
example_sentence: The hapless tourist dropped his phone in the canal.
